name: 33rd Street Outfall
description: A stormwater outfall structure along the South Platte corridor in Denver's Globeville neighborhood.

name: Big Dry Creek (ArapCo)
description: Big Dry Creek flows through Arapahoe County, providing flood control and open space along its corridor.

name: Boulder Creek
description: Boulder Creek runs through the heart of Boulder, emerging from the Rocky Mountains and threading through downtown.

name: Cherry Creek
description: Cherry Creek is a major tributary of the South Platte River, flowing through southeast Denver and the Cherry Creek Reservoir.

name: Clear Creek
description: Clear Creek carves through the foothills near Golden before flowing east across Jefferson and Adams counties.

name: First Creek Park
description: First Creek Park in Denver and Aurora features a restored creek channel and naturalized floodplain.

name: Grange Hall Creek
description: Grange Hall Creek is a tributary in Westminster that has been improved with urban stormwater infrastructure.

name: Little Dry Creek ADCO
description: Little Dry Creek in Adams County serves as a key drainage corridor through the Commerce City area.

name: Niver Creek Ruston Park
description: Niver Creek runs through Ruston Park in Thornton, featuring naturalized banks and riparian habitat.

name: Sanderson Gulch
description: Sanderson Gulch drains southwest Denver neighborhoods and flows to the South Platte River near Bear Creek.

name: SPR Confluence Park
description: Confluence Park is where Cherry Creek meets the South Platte River in lower downtown Denver — a landmark urban waterway space.

name: SPR River Run
description: The South Platte River Run corridor south of downtown Denver offers multi-use trail access along a restored river channel.

name: SPR
description: A reach of the South Platte River flowing through central Denver, the backbone of the district's urban river system.

name: Van Bibber Drop 2
description: Van Bibber Creek flows through Arvada and features engineered grade control structures like this drop to prevent erosion.

name: West Fork of Kenneys Run
description: The West Fork of Kenneys Run drains a portion of Aurora's eastern neighborhoods before joining the main channel.

name: Wonderland Creek
description: Wonderland Creek flows through north Boulder near Wonderland Lake, a natural open space beloved by the community.
